subject.title: fix(compaction): emit after_compaction on no-op and use JSON-safe validator delimiters (#81925)

question: After repairing mixed-version fallback detection, should successful no-op compactions emit public `after_compaction` events with `compactedCount: 0` and optional `reason`?
rationale: The fallback repair is mechanical, but widening a public plugin event's delivery semantics and payload vocabulary requires API-owner intent.

options.title: Approve current hook contract
options.body: Treat `after_compaction` as completion of every successful compaction attempt and accept the optional reason field.

options.title: Approve event pairing only
options.body: Emit successful no-op completion events but defer the new public reason field.

options.title: Coordinate adjacent hook work
options.body: Align this payload with the open compaction-summary proposal before finalizing either API change.

recommendation.title: Approve current hook contract
recommendation.body: Treat `after_compaction` as completion of every successful compaction attempt and accept the optional reason field.
